sentences.en: The one resource more precious than any other was land.
sentences.zh: 比其他任何资源都更加珍贵的是土地。

sentences.en: The philosopher's stone could transmute every precious metal into gold.
sentences.zh: 哲学家石可以将每一种珍贵金属变成黄金。

sentences.en: Every language is equally precious and valuable to its speakers.
sentences.zh: 每种语言对说这种语言的人来说都是同样珍贵和有价值的。

senses.zh: 宝贵的，珍贵的；贵重的；矫揉造作的
